questions: Tell me about a difficult decision.
How would you decide which feature to build first?

demo.question: How would you decide which feature to build first?
demo.answer: Start with the customer problem that matters most. Compare expected impact, evidence and effort, then test the biggest uncertainty before committing.
demo.cues:
Start with the customer problem that matters most.
• Impact: Who benefits, and how much?
• Evidence: What shows the problem is real?
• Effort: Smallest useful version.
• Test: Resolve the riskiest assumption first.
